formula_or_clause: D_v K_hat = D_v Delta_K + D_v K_metric[Gamma_eff]
interpretation: This separates the true Khat mismatch from the Gamma-driven metric-response piece.

required_input: K_hat must equal the variational metric response to Gamma_eff, including connection/domain/boundary terms.
interpretation: Would remove the independent trace-free residual leakage.

formula_or_clause: D_v K_metric[Gamma_eff] = K_metric'[Gamma_eff] D_v Gamma_eff + connection/domain/boundary kernels
required_input: If D_v Gamma_eff=0 and all kernels descend, this term can vanish.
interpretation: Depends on the D_v Gamma_eff gate plus the 1010 Helmholtz/action-existence route.

formula_or_clause: D_v K_hat_memory = (D_v b_mem) S_m + b_mem D_v S_m + connection/g_obs terms
required_input: Only valid if a memory-gradient ansatz is explicitly adopted for K_hat.
interpretation: Possible coefficient route, not a parent definition.

formula_or_clause: C_DvKhat_total := |P_obs nabla_mu(D_v Delta_K^{mu nu}+D_v K_metric[Gamma_eff]^{mu nu})|/a_ref
required_input: Requires sourced Delta_K tensor norm, metric-response kernels, projection P_obs and local acceleration/reference norm.
interpretation: This is the first measurable coefficient if Khat equality cannot be proved.
